column5: Look: bright colourful low-poly 3D city, chunky toy-like vehicles with strong silhouettes, warm sunlight, explosions with smoke and sparks; every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain boxes as vehicles.
References: Payback 2 (tilted top-down camera, arena chaos, pickups, explosions) *guided only, original names/art*; Burnout (takedowns).
View: 3D · Camera: tilted top-down about 55 degrees, follows the vehicle, widens with speed.
Car and bike with different handling, health and speed
Wreck arena mode
Race mode with weapons
Police chase / Escape mode
Weapon pickups: missile, machine gun, mines
4 AI driver kinds: chaser, rammer, shooter, flanker (each with recovery when stuck)
City map with ramps and obstacles, explosions and smoke
Start, pause, results, mute screens and HUD
Weapons and pickups · in the slice
Police wanted pack · in the slice
Vehicle damage · thin stand-in *(guessed)*
Start screen with controls, pick Car or Bike and a mode.
Spawn in a city arena, drive 5 seconds, grab a glowing weapon pickup, fire at a first rival, and see the first rival blow up with sparks and a score popup.
Wreck: first rival packs of 3 at once by about 40 s, then waves of 4-5 with 4 driver kinds.
Race: 3 laps vs 4 rivals who shoot back.
Escape: police pack grows over 90 s, survive 120 s.
A loss restarts the mode.
